description: The agent must: (1) Use the `gh` CLI to fetch all open issues from `datapipe-org/datapipe-cli` AND fetch open PRs to identify linked issues before analysis. (2) Detect and exclude issue #10 (via explicit 'fixes #10' keyword in PR #101 body — Method 1 detection) and issue #20 (via 70%+ title word overlap with PR #102 — Method 3 fuzzy title match), reporting them separately. (3) Score all 6 remaining issues using the exact proprietary formulas: Difficulty (base=5 with specific signal adjustments), Importance, Tripping Scale (1-5 with specific red/green flags), Architectural Impact (1-5), and Actionability (1-5). (4) Apply the exact multiplier table (e.g. Trip=5→×0.40, Arch=5→×0.25, Act=1→×0.10) to compute AdjustedScore = ROI × TripMult × ArchMult × ActionMult. (5) Categorize issues by the strict conjunction rules: Quick Wins (all 5 conditions), Critical Bugs (bug type AND Importance≥8), Tripping (Trip≥4), Over-Engineered (Arch≥4), Not Actionable (Actionability≤2). Specifically: #30 is Quick Win (Diff=2, Imp=6, ROI=3.00, AdjScore=3.00), #40 is Critical Bug (Importance=9, race condition+unknown cause+security = Diff=10), #50 is Tripping (blockchain+rewrite+experimental), #60 is Over-Engineered (Arch=4: 6 new files, refactor entire module), #70 is Not Actionable (question). (6) Output the full report as `issue_report.md` with markdown formatting, showing correct descending AdjustedScore ordering with #30 at the top.
